author: Bay State News
title: Canton announces water shutoff on Revere Street scheduled for May 1
text:
The Town of Canton Water Department announced on Apr. 29 that water service will be temporarily shut off for a section of Revere Street on Friday, May 1, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
The interruption will affect residents and businesses along Revere Street from Washington Street to the Fire Station. The department said the shutdown is necessary to make a new connection for the recently installed water main on Revere Court.
After service is restored, officials are asking affected customers to run a cold-water faucet in their tub or an outside spigot until any air is removed and the water runs clear. This step helps ensure that air pockets and any sediment stirred up during maintenance are flushed out of household plumbing systems.
“We apologize for any inconvenience,” the Town of Canton Water Department said in its announcement.
Water main upgrades like this one are part of ongoing efforts by local utilities to maintain reliable service and improve infrastructure. Residents with questions about the planned shutdown can contact the town’s water department for more information.
